text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the big deal? Look at you,
all
hunched over.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Something troublin' ya? Come on, lay it
on me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I mean, no guarantees I'll be able to
solve your
problem, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing worse than keepin' it
bottled up!
Just let it all out, and you'll
feel better in no time!
